run_starlette_app: run the starlette app with gzip middleware and optional cors for speech recognition inference
build_pipeline_from_env: build a cached pipeline instance using the TASK and MODEL_ID environment variables
create_allowed_tasks_dict: create a dictionary mapping task names like automatic-speech-recognition to their pipeline classes
configure_startup_event: configure the startup event to initialize logging and eagerly load the pipeline
review_starlette_routes: review the starlette routes that handle get status checks and post pipeline requests
